channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Diesel prices are soaring, pushing Vermont loggers to the brink. Rising fuel costs add to struggles from mill closures and equipment expenses. The future of Vermont's logging industry is at risk.

Two people were arrested in Rutland City in a fentanyl trafficking case. Police seized nearly twelve grams of suspected fentanyl at Sheldon Towers. Authorities urge anyone with information to contact Rutland City police.

Vermont's muzzleloader season for antlerless deer opens October twenty-ninth. Hunters need specific licenses and permits to participate. Youth hunters should report their deer in person during the November seventh and eighth weekend.

A man found dead on Camel’s Hump in Huntington has been identified as Jason April, fifty, from Denver. Police say his death is not suspicious, with an autopsy pending. The trail was closed briefly but is now open again.
